2cbb226223ecbcda5bb3fea4ab48f1d0c4db2d0f.rationale: Serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay, which is a specific marker for Neuromyelitis Optica

Neuromyelitis Optica: F5: Persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
F6: Unremarkable brain MRI scans prior to 2012
F16: Unremarkable CSF analysis with no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis, no oligoclonal bands, and a normal cell count
F3: Four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
F4: Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
F13: Brain MRI showed a large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
F14: Smaller T2 lesions on the right without clear evidence of a disturbed blood–brain barrier
F19: Serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay
